payload.title: M2 — Bring reusable animation demos into VideoML
payload.description:
## Outcome
Selected existing Babulus demos become reusable VideoML examples while Babulus continues to consume them.

## Ownership
stdlib, player, toolchain, videoml-org; Babulus as consumer

## Completion
All child behavior stories have implementation and verification evidence. Update the parent initiative body with decisions, coverage, and remaining work. This is planned work, not a claim that the features already ship.
